brief_summary: In this randomized controlled trial, we will examine the effect of a 3-month exercise training (aerobic exercise versus resistance exercise) without calorie restriction on total and regional adiposity, and risk of type 2 diabetes in overweight children and adolescents.
brief_title: Physical Activity in Youth: Implications for Reversing Risk Factors for Type 2 Diabetes

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy overweight (BMI \>-95th) youth between 12 and 18 years of age
* Waist circumference \>-75th percentile
* Sedentary (no structured exercise \>2 times/week for past 6 months)
* Non-smokers, non-diabetic, no medical conditions
* Weight stable for past 3 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Smokers,
* diabetic,
* psychiatric disorders,
* syndromatic obesity

official_title: Physical Activity in Youth: Implications for Reversing Risk Factors for Type 2 Diabetes

sites.facility: Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, University of Pittsburgh School of Medicine
